logs.label: Logs
logs.description: Logs important server actions and adds the /clear command.

clear.description: Quickly delete messages in the current channel.

opt.count: Number of messages to delete (1 to 100).
opt.member: Only delete messages from one member.

clear.invalidChannel: ❌ This command must be used in a server text channel.
clear.botNoPerm: ❌ I do not have the “Manage Messages” permission in this channel.
clear.failed: ❌ Could not delete these messages. Check my permissions.

rollback.missing: ❌ This rollback cannot be found or has expired.
rollback.notAllowed: ⛔ You are not allowed to use this rollback.
rollback.unsupported: ❌ This rollback type is not supported.
rollback.noPermission: ❌ I do not have the required permissions to restore this item.
rollback.failed: ❌ Could not restore this item. Check my permissions and hierarchy.
